title: From Idea to Prototype in an Afternoon: Scaffolded, AI-Assisted Rapid VA Prototyping
abstract: arXiv:2606.31311v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Testing a new visual-analytics idea usually takes months: one needs to find a realistic data set, clean it, and implement an interactive prototype. We describe a case where a workflow language and an AI assistant reduced this effort to one afternoon. The idea under test: relax the Pareto frontier with a tolerance and group the surviving options into recurring types -- ``constellations'' on a ``soft sky''. Using the Artifact--Transform Workflow Language (ATWL) as a scaffold, we obtained a consistent workflow in minutes and a running prototype in a few hours. We derive three lessons. The scaffold matters: without ATWL the assistant produced a naive workflow. The scaffold alone is not enough: the first implementation was only average, and expert knowledge injection was needed to reach state-of-the-art quality. translated_title: 从创意到原型仅需一个下午：基于脚手架与AI辅助的快速可视化分析原型构建
translated_abstract: 测试一个新的可视化分析想法通常需要数月时间：需要找到真实数据集、进行清洗，并实现一个交互式原型。我们描述了一个案例，其中工作流语言和AI助手将这一过程缩短至一个下午。待测试的想法是：用容差放宽帕累托前沿，并将幸存选项分组为重复出现的类型——即“软天空”上的“星座”。使用Artifact--Transform工作流语言（ATWL）作为脚手架，我们在几分钟内获得了一致的工作流，并在几小时内得到了可运行的原型。我们总结出三点经验：脚手架至关重要——没有ATWL，助手生成了幼稚的工作流；仅有脚手架还不够——首次实现仅达到平均水平，需要注入专家知识才能达到最先进的质量；最后，脚手架的使用方式很重要——对照实验表明，语言定义和示例库的结合是关键。
tldr: 本文展示了通过工作流语言（ATWL）作为脚手架结合AI助手，将可视化分析原型开发从数月缩短至一个下午，并强调脚手架、专家知识注入及正确使用方式对提升原型质量的关键作用。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that using a workflow language (ATWL) as a scaffold with an AI assistant reduces visual-analytics prototyping from months to an afternoon, highlighting the critical roles of scaffolding, expert knowledge injection, and proper usage for achieving high-quality results.
